LanguageData.LP_Sub_Oathbreaker.label: Oathbreaker
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Oathbreaker.description: A fallen paladin who has forsaken their oath and given themself to darkness: no tenets, and can't break an oath. Channel Oath once per day (twice at level 11, three times at 15), no divinity cost, used to spread fear and control undead and fiends; the aura of hate makes you and nearby undead and fiends fiercer in melee, and finally you become a Dread Lord.
